name: Frost Mage
blurb: Teleports to a safe spot when hit. Ultimate: Blizzard drops ice balls on the enemy.

sfx.ultimate: howling blizzard wind with icy crystalline burst

art.floor: pale blue frosted stone floor tiles with faint ice cracks
art.body: a female frost mage: a perfectly round ball body wearing elegant white and icy blue robes with silver trim, long flowing golden blonde hair, a calm young woman's face with bright blue eyes, a small silver circlet, a high collar
weapons: a slim silver wizard staff with a glowing pale blue ice crystal at the right end

projectiles.orb: a sharp glowing pale blue ice shard crystal with a small frost trail

art.ultimate_icon: a single large pale blue six-pointed snowflake with white sparkles
art.ult_circle: a pale blue frost circle with snowflake runes
art.ult_aura: a swirling white snowstorm aura with floating ice shards
art.hit_fx: a small burst of pale blue ice shards
